title: Group Anagrams
description: Given an array of strings `strs`, group the anagrams together. Output the size of each anagram group in descending order.
input_format: First line contains integer `n`, followed by `n` strings.

sample_tests.input:
6
eat tea tan ate nat bat

hints: Two strings are in the same group if their sorted representations are equal.
Use a hash map where key is `tuple(sorted(string))`.
Sort the resulting group lengths in descending order.

reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    n = int(data[0])
    strs = data[1:1+n]
    from collections import defaultdict
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for s in strs:
        key = ''.join(sorted(s))
        groups[key].append(s)
    sizes = sorted([len(v) for v in groups.values()], reverse=True)
    print(' '.join(map(str, sizes)))
